A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Good questions.

Everything to know about exploring this collection today.

Can I order a keyboard here?

Not yet. This site lets you explore colors and save combinations. Ordering will become available after pricing, inventory, payments, and fulfillment are confirmed.

Which colors can I combine?

Choose Milk, Denim blue, Sand honey, Ice blue, Muted wine, or Graphite keycaps with a Silver aluminum, Ivory, Deep blue, or Black case.

Are the pictures product photographs?

The website uses original SVG illustrations inspired by the supplied reference images. These are previews, not photographs or guarantees of exact color or material.

Which languages are on the keys?

The supplied references show English and Russian legends. Final layout and compatibility details should be checked against the production specification before ordering.

What switches, connectivity, and materials are used?

These specifications have not been verified. Switch types, hot-swap support, connection modes, battery, dimensions, weight, case construction, and operating system support will be published when confirmed.

How do saved builds work?

Save a combination to this browser using the configurator. You can also download an SVG build card or copy a URL that recreates your selection. Local saves do not sync between devices.

What are the shipping and returns policies?

Shipping regions, delivery estimates, warranty terms, returns, and support contact details are not set yet. These policies must be published before checkout launches.
